rr-broiled-fish.title: He eats before them
rr-broiled-fish.alt: The risen Jesus holds a piece of fish while two disciples watch Him indoors.
rr-broiled-fish.caption: Luke records the risen Jesus eating before His disciples. This scene illustrates that indoor witness, distinct from the shore breakfast in John 21.
